pokedexEntries.rb: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

pokedexEntries.ye: Uses its alluring eyes to enrapture its foe. It then sings a pleasing melody that lulls the foe to sleep.

pokedexEntries.go: If it inflates to SING a lullaby, it can perform longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.

pokedexEntries.si: Looking into its cute, round eyes causes it to sing a relaxing melody, inducing its enemies to sleep.

pokedexEntries.cr: It rolls its cute eyes as it sings a soothing lullaby. Its gentle song puts anyone who hears it to sleep.

pokedexEntries.ru: JIGGLYPUFF’s vocal chords can freely adjust the wavelength of its voice. This POKéMON uses this ability to sing at precisely the right wavelength to make its foes most drowsy.

pokedexEntries.sa: When this POKéMON sings, it never pauses to breathe. If it is in a battle against an opponent that does not easily fall asleep, JIGGLYPUFF cannot breathe, endangering its life.

pokedexEntries.fr: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.

pokedexEntries.lg: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

pokedexEntries.em: Nothing can avoid falling asleep hearing a JIGGLYPUFF’s song. The sound waves of its singing voice match the brain waves of someone in a deep sleep.

pokedexEntries.dpp: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.

pokedexEntries.hg: If it inflates to sing a lullaby, it can perform longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.

pokedexEntries.ss: Looking into its cute, round eyes causes it to sing a relaxing melody, inducing its enemies to sleep.

pokedexEntries.bw: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Looking into its cute, round eyes makes it start singing a song so pleasant listeners can’t help but fall asleep.

pokedexEntries.x: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.

pokedexEntries.y: If it inflates to sing a lullaby, it can perform longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.

pokedexEntries.or: Jigglypuff’s vocal cords can freely adjust the wavelength of its voice. This Pokémon uses this ability to sing at precisely the right wavelength to make its foes most drowsy.

pokedexEntries.as: When this Pokémon sings, it never pauses to breathe. If it is in a battle against an opponent that does not easily fall asleep, Jigglypuff cannot breathe, endangering its life.

pokedexEntries.su: It hugely inflates its stomach and sings a mysterious melody. If you hear this melody, you’ll become sleepy right away.

pokedexEntries.mo: Jigglypuff possess a vocal range that exceeds 12 octaves, but each individual’s singing skill depends on its own effort.

pokedexEntries.us: Recordings of Jigglypuff’s strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

pokedexEntries.um: The songs they sing are totally different depending on the region they live in. Some even sound like they’re shouting!

pokedexEntries.lgpe: Uses its cute round eyes to enrapture its foe. It then sings a pleasing melody that lulls the foe to sleep.

pokedexEntries.sw: Jigglypuff has top-notch lung capacity, even by comparison to other Pokémon. It won’t stop singing its lullabies until its foes fall asleep.

pokedexEntries.sh: By freely changing the wavelength of its voice, Jigglypuff sings a mysterious melody sure to make any listener sleepy.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.
